# isEmpty

<link-summary>Checks whether a value is empty.</link-summary>

<web-summary>isEmpty() — Checks whether a value is empty. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/base</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function isEmpty(value: unknown, strict: boolean = false): boolean;
```

Emptiness is read per kind: `null` and `undefined`, a string with nothing but whitespace, an array, `Set` or `Map` with no entries, an object with no own keys. `0` and `false` are values, not emptiness.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter                       | Type      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| :------------------------------ | :-------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value`                         | `unknown` | The value to check.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `strict` _(optional)_ `= false` | `boolean` | The strictness mode for string validation. - If `false` (default), strings containing only whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, newlines) are considered empty (using `trim()`). This is known as "blank" check. - If `true`, only a string with zero length (`""`) is considered empty. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the value is empty; otherwise `false`.

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
isEmpty(null); // => true
isEmpty(""); // => true
isEmpty("   "); // => true
isEmpty([]); // => true
isEmpty({}); // => true
isEmpty(new Map()); // => true
isEmpty(0); // => false
isEmpty(false); // => false
isEmpty("a"); // => false
isEmpty([0]); // => false
```
